crossApp.name: reference-palette-distance
crossApp.detail: mean ΔE2000 from the reference's top colors to the template palette (reported, not gated)

notes: Scope: three samples per app. Every path is under showcase/runs/graphite-blueprint/1.1.0-rc.6/<app>/20261017-230515-s<N>/ unless it says otherwise. Gates pass in all 12 runs (eval-1.md). Palette consistency is 1.0 in every sample. Type consistency is 0.734 in s1 and 0.888 in s2 and s3. Reference palette distance is 0.18. The scores below describe the typical sample. A finding lowers a score only when it shows up in at least 2 of 3 samples, or when the spec causes it.

Recurring findings (count against the prompt). R1, spacing, 2 of 3 (s2, s3), caused by the spec: settings group gaps of 64/60 and 56 against 48, explained under N11. R2, signature, 3 of 3, caused by the spec: the commerce grid's third row repeats row 1's kinds in the same columns. The order is perspective, sphere, dot matrix under perspective, sphere, dot matrix (commerce/s1,s2,s3/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png). specKinds is deterministic, with a window of 7 over 8 kinds, so items 9 to 11 always reuse kinds 1 to 3, and in a 4-column grid they sit in the same columns. The reference's thumbnail rows never echo a column (pipeline/linear-study/reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png, changelog row). Minor. R3, polish, 3 of 3, mostly the base app: on product detail no nav pill is current ('Shop' unmarked, commerce/s*/screenshots/products-canvas-field-tote-desktop-light.png). The base app's Shop NavLink uses `end` (showcase/base-apps/commerce/src/components/Layout.tsx:27), so the agent needs a section-level visual state. Minor. R4, polish, 2 of 3 (s2, s3): app tables inset their first and last cells by 12px, so 'PROJECT' starts at x 284 under a 'Projects' head at 272, and 'STATUS' ends at 1396 against 'SHOWING 8 OF 8 PROJECTS' at 1408 (dashboard/s2,s3/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png; s1 is flush at 272/1408). The reference's lists keep text on the section edge (p1-desktop-light.png, changelog). Minor, not scored on its own.

Reference fidelity (4): the reference's language without copying it, in every sample. A near-black ground with paper light mode, inverse pills, Inter with tight tracking, mono uppercase captions, 48px split openers, two-tone one-line display closings over the dot field, hairline grids of generative plates, and the teal current column on a quiet stage (blog/s*/about-desktop-dark.png, commerce/s*/home-desktop-dark.png, dashboard/s*/home-desktop-dark.png vs pipeline/linear-study/reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png). Section spacing is airy, as in the reference: about 300px between sections, where the reference runs about 370px from figure row to the next headline. Not a 5: the blueprints are single clean outlines with a dot core. The reference's stack has six ribbed tiers and an inner sliced disc (blog/s1/drawings/about-d1.png vs reference/illustrations/p1-i5.png).

Cross-app consistency (4): one family in every sample. Screen heads have a mono eyebrow, h1 and a two-tone summary, apps use 'nn / nn' section heads, banners sit above the actions, counts are mono and pins are right-aligned. Drift between samples rather than between apps: the KPI tiles are separate cards in s1/s2 and a joined hairline grid in s3, and the eyebrow wording varies. Both are allowed. Type consistency dips to 0.734 in s1, still above the gate.

Hierarchy (4): masthead, then the featured plate inside the first viewport, then the grid. App screens read head, KPIs, chart and activity, then table. Articles read title, meta, lead plate, body, with the contents as a rail. The one lapse, the missing opener on s3's figure row (V1), is variance.

Spacing rhythm (3): the settings rule (48px from a group's last content to the next rule) is still broken in the typical sample, 2 of 3. The billing gap is 64 after plans, and the security form is about 56 on mobile. The spec's own recipe causes it: an empty live region after the last block still takes the column's gap. This is the fourth iteration that has targeted the gap. Everything else holds in 3 of 3: N10 and N15 are fixed, opener to prose is about 55px, columns end together, table rows are equal, and the mobile tables are clean.

Component states (4): focus is an indigo ring layered over the red error border. Inline errors sit under each field, with a '<n> fields need attention' banner directly above the actions (commerce/s2,s3/state-checkout-errors-desktop-dark.png, settings/s1/state-profile-errors-desktop-dark.png, settings/s2/state-password-mismatch-desktop-dark.png with the dot-meter 'Strength: Strong'). The empty filter shows the dot glyph, 'NO RESULTS', a line and 'Clear filters', with the focused search ringed (dashboard/s2/state-empty-filter-desktop-dark.png). The plan dialog is a bottom sheet with a mono 'PLAN CHANGE' (settings/s3/state-plan-dialog-mobile-light.png). The empty cart shows a slab stack and 'CART EMPTY' (commerce/s1/cart-desktop-dark.png). Not a 5: no pending state was captured (harness gap).

Polish (4): the four rc.5 polish regressions (N9, N10, N13, N14) are fixed in 3 of 3, with no default-browser leftovers. What recurs is minor: no current pill on product detail (R3, mostly the base app) and the 12px table inset in s2/s3 (R4). The s3 blog rule-hugging pattern and the tiny initials are variance.

Signature (4): every element is in all four apps in all three samples, placed as Applying the concept says. That covers fact-captioned plates in the commerce and blog grids, the lead plates and the product detail on a quiet stage; the about row of three at about 274px; tier slabs on plan cards; the slab stack on the empty cart; dot meters on team and password strength; the empty dot glyph; quiet stages for the chart, the product image and s1's member-card preview; and dot-field closings. Chart-in motion: 420ms on cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94). The columns rise from the base and the teal OCT column lands with the rest by about 490ms, in all three samples (dashboard/s3/motion/motion-m1.png; s1/s2 shots.json motion identical: chart-in, 0 loops). Not a 5: blueprint craft is below the reference's p1-i5, and the plate grid repeats columns (R2).

Not penalized, known harness gaps and base-app content: no real pending request, so no scan glyph or shimmer was captured. Full-page captures show the sticky header mid-page and the blurred dialog backdrop (settings/s1/state-profile-errors-desktop-dark.png, settings/s3/state-plan-dialog-mobile-light.png). Motion frames come from the first route only. 'Account Settings', title-case data and the always-visible '0' cart count come from the base apps. Agents cannot run browser measurements, so the spec's 'measure and paste' lines go unfulfilled.

Bar: 4, 4, 4, 3, 4, 4, 4, an average of 3.86 with nothing below 3. It does not clear the bar. The update reached its goal for N9, N10, N12, N13, N14 and N15 (3 of 3 each) and kept every earlier item. The one open item is the settings 48px gap, fixed in 1 of 3 samples, and the spec causes it, so a single recipe fix should close it. Against published 1.0.0, nothing is worse in 2 or more samples and the whole is clearly better.
promptFixes:
Spacing (R1, settings gaps 64/56 in s2 and s3, spec gap): in Spacing's .settings-group recipe, add the case the CSS misses. An always-present but empty live region (`role=status`, e.g. the base app's plan-status or password-status `

`) must not take the column's gap. Add `.settings-group [role=status]:empty{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}`: hidden visually, still in the accessibility tree, so announcements keep working. Say that a filled status line shows in normal flow. Add to the Check line: 'with every status region empty, the gap from the last visible block of each settings group to the next rule is 48px (check billing after the plan grid and security after Update password)'. The agents cannot measure, so the rule has to be mechanical. Evidence: settings/20261017-230515-s2/screenshots/settings-billing-desktop-light.png (594 to 658) and s3 (607 to 671), settings/s2,s3/screenshots/settings-security-mobile-dark.png (about 56 CSS px), the cause in settings/s2/app/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx:87 and s3 BillingPage.tsx:97 with the spec CSS copied verbatim in s2 base.css:359-377. Compare s1 (48, settings/s1/screenshots/settings-billing-desktop-light.png).

Signature (R2, column repeat in 3 of 3, caused by the spec's specKinds): make the second pass over the kinds start offset, so a kind never comes back in the same column at 2, 3 or 4 columns. For example, in specKinds use `kind = order[(i + Math.floor(i/8)*3) % 8]`, or reverse the order on odd passes. Add to Limits: 'no kind repeats in the same column of a grid at 2, 3 or 4 columns'. Evidence: commerce/20261017-230515-s1,s2,s3/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png (row 3 perspective, sphere, dot matrix under row 1's), against the reference's non-repeating thumbnail row (pipeline/linear-study/reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png).

Polish (R3, no current nav pill on product detail, 3 of 3): in Navigation add 'a detail route marks its parent section current visually (for example, a `data-section` on the layout root set from the pathname, styled like the current pill) and never changes the base app's NavLink `end` or aria-current'. Evidence: commerce/20261017-230515-s1,s2,s3/screenshots/products-canvas-field-tote-desktop-light.png ('Shop' unmarked) vs home-desktop-dark.png ('Shop' marked); showcase/base-apps/commerce/src/components/Layout.tsx:27.

Polish (R4, minor, 2 of 3): in Table add 'the first and last cell text sits on the section's edges, the same x as the section head and its right-hand count (`th:first-child,td:first-child{padding-left:0} th:last-child,td:last-child{padding-right:0}`); only a table inside a card is inset'. Evidence: dashboard/20261017-230515-s2,s3/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png ('PROJECT' at x 284 under 'Projects' at 272; 'STATUS' at 1396 vs 'SHOWING…' at 1408) vs s1 (flush at 272/1408).

Process, harness, not scored: in 6 of 12 runs the agent says it could not take the 'measure and paste' numbers. Either give the run's agent a measuring command (pigment-snap printing getBoundingClientRect for `.bp-fig`, `.settings-group` gaps and right-aligned heads), or turn the remaining measured checks into recipe CSS, as fix 1 does.
